1. Enterprise SA Selection Decision Tree (R600)
Agent Social Scheduler MCP, Source-Cited Client Brain, Tedix & Mojito
Q1: Social Media Scheduler Built for AI Agents (MCP/REST)?
• trypostit/trypost (★1469, AGPL-3.0, PHP):
Agents create, schedule & publish posts across networks
via native MCP server or REST API + human team composer
• Replaces expensive per-channel SaaS schedulers (Buffer/Hootsuite)
Q2: Source-Cited Client Project Brain (Rails + PG)?
• lalabase/lalabase (★156, AGPL-3.0, Ruby on Rails + PG):
Shared client space: requirements, meetings, tickets & docs
AI assistant answers with exact ticket & time-entry citations
• Example: "38.5 hours across 12 tickets" with linked sources
Q3: Shared Tasks, Knowledge, Apps & Approvals for Agents?
• tedix-hq/tedix (★43, AGPL-3.0, TypeScript):
Unified workspace coordinating people, AI agents & apps
First-class engineering decision records & approval gates
• Keeps agent actions anchored to shared project knowledge
Q4: Self-Rebuilding Local Personal AI (`mojito`)?
• TimeLovercc/mojito (★120, MIT, TypeScript):
Local evolving alternative to cloud personal AI (Meta Muse)
Documented `self-rebuild-loop.md` rewrites the app via chat
• 100% local MIT ownership with security boundary docs
2. End-to-End Enterprise Client Delivery, Agent Collaboration, Self-Rebuilding Apps & Social MCP
Four-Pillar Milestone Stack: Lalabase Cited Client Brain ➔ Tedix Decision Hub ➔ Mojito Self-Rebuild Loop ➔ TryPost MCP
Pillar A: Agent Social Scheduler (trypostit/trypost)
• Dual Agent + Human Workflow: AI agents draft and schedule
multi-network posts via MCP or REST API; humans review in
a collaborative visual composer
• High Community Adoption: ★1,469 stars & 307 forks
• Self-Hosted Control: Eliminates per-seat/per-channel fees
on commercial social media management SaaS platforms
• License: AGPL-3.0 (deploy as internal standalone service)
✓ Turns multi-channel content publishing into an MCP tool call
Pillar B: Source-Cited Client Brain (lalabase/lalabase)
• First Call to Production: Unifies client requirements,
meeting notes, tickets, time logs & project documentation
• Citation-Grounded Project AI: Answers billing & scope
questions (e.g. "38.5 hours across 12 tickets") with exact
links to the underlying tickets and time entries
• Proven Stack: Ruby on Rails + PostgreSQL (★156 stars)
• License: AGPL-3.0-only (self-hosted delivery portal)
✓ Eliminates client billing disputes with source-cited AI
Pillar C: Agent & App Decision Hub (tedix-hq/tedix)
• Four-Way Coordination: Connects human teams, AI agents,
internal apps & project knowledge in one TypeScript platform
• Structured Approval Workflows: Captures engineering
decisions and requires explicit sign-off on high-impact actions
• Shared Context Graph: Agents read and update shared
tasks and project docs without siloed chat amnesia
• License: AGPL-3.0 (internal team collaboration service)
✓ Centralizes human-in-the-loop engineering decisions
Pillar D: Self-Rebuilding Personal AI (TimeLovercc/mojito)
• Self-Rebuild Loop (`docs/self-rebuild-loop.md`): Describe
a new feature or workflow in chat, and Mojito rewrites and
rebuilds its own TypeScript codebase on the fly
• Local Sovereign Alternative: Built as an open-source,
locally owned alternative to cloud personal AIs like Meta Muse
• Bilingual Guides: English & Chinese research documentation
• License: Permissive MIT License (★120 stars)
✓ Empowers engineers to evolve bespoke local tools via chat
